review.why: Plans a product or feature launch with owned, rented and borrowed channels, a readiness gate, five phases, a Product Hunt plan and checklists.
review.summary: Sorts channels into owned, rented and borrowed, then applies a readiness gate (simple, lovable, complete) before five phases from internal launch to full launch. It adds a Product Hunt plan with two case studies, post-launch work, a matrix for how much to announce each update, and pre-launch, launch-day and post-launch checklists.
strengths: Readiness gate names two opposite failures: never shipping and endless scope
Matrix sizes the announcement to the update
Turns merged changes into release notes through a reference
cautions: Case-study figures are brief and unsourced
Site QA and shipped-changes guides are in files not read here
